verses.englishText: By the fig and the olive[1947]
verses.footnotes: [1947] Referring to the places known for their production, i.e., Damascus and Jerusalem, respectively. It could also refer to the fig and olive trees or to the fruits themselves.

verses.arabicText: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
verses.englishText: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;[1948]
verses.footnotes: [1948] i.e., upright, symmetrical, and balanced in form and nature.

verses.englishText: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,[1949]
verses.footnotes: [1949] This can refer to the depths of Hell, to decrepit old age or to immorality.

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
verses.englishText: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?[1950]
verses.footnotes: [1950] More literally, "What makes you lie concerning it?"

verses.englishText: Is not Allāh the most just of judges?
